frames.caption: 第一笔选择稳定版本 R17。实例通过鉴权后的身份向服务取选择视图，规则和指针与 g 一起读取，不能从几个代次拼出来。Begin with steady release R17. Use authenticated instance identity and read the rule, pointers, and generation as one selected view.
第二笔加 R18 的金丝雀路径。两组读的是同一权威视图允许的不同内容，新旧并存由规则决定，不能靠通知快慢来挑选。Add the R18 canary path. Both cohorts use one authoritative view; rules determine the difference rather than notification timing.

5% 分桶是稳定哈希的预期比例。10,000 × 5% = 500 是容量估算，并非保证正好 500 个实例；精确个数要显式名单。A stable hash produces an expected percentage. 10,000 × 5% = 500 is a sizing estimate, not an exact cohort count; exact counts require an explicit list.

本帧仍是 g42/5%；5%→20% 只是扩围原则旁注，并未在本帧执行。真正扩围要发新 g 并保留 salt；下一帧直接从 g42 回退到 g43/R17。This frame remains g42/5%; 5%→20% is a policy note, not an executed expansion. Actual expansion needs a new g with the same salt. The next frame rolls directly from g42 to g43/R17.

终图用 g=43 回到 R17。它可以复用旧内容，不需要伪造新正文；代次前进、规则和审计原子提交，SDK 能接受这次合法回退。Abort by publishing g=43 selecting R17 again. Reuse old bytes while generation advances and the rule plus audit commit atomically; SDKs accept the valid rollback.

先算连接：每进程一条、空闲 60 秒，10,000 / 60 ≈ 167 次续约/秒。它们落在服务连接表，不能直接加成数据库读 QPS。One watch per process, held for 60 idle seconds, gives 10,000 / 60 ≈ 167 renewals/s. These belong to the service connection table, not automatically to database reads.

第二笔拒绝按 namespace 每 5 秒空转：20,000 QPS / 167 ≈ 120 倍。但变更时要额外续约，167 只代表空闲稳态。Reject 5-second polling per namespace: 20,000 QPS / 167 ≈ 120×. Changes cause extra renewals, so 167 describes idle steady state only.

每个进程 10 × 40 KB = 400 KB。全体冷拉是 4 GB；打散到 30 秒平均 133.3 MB/s，约 1.07 Gb/s，远大于旧稿的 400 MB 总量。Each process needs 10 × 40 KB = 400 KB. A fleet cold fetch is 4 GB; spread over 30 seconds it averages 133.3 MB/s, about 1.07 Gb/s.

正文按不可变内容 ID 缓存并单飞回源。缓存命中只省正文读，不能证明 Current 最新，也不能替安全开关续权威证明。Cache immutable content IDs and coalesce origin reads. A byte-cache hit saves a payload read but proves neither a fresh Current view nor critical-key authority.

向下虚线是 applied 遥测，重连 GET 仍走 Config Service。右侧恢复预算按 10 个 namespace 的批响应计；上方 500 人/0.25 秒则是单包大范围发布的接收者准入，两笔不能混用。The downward dashed arrow reports applied state; reconnect GETs still use Config Service. Recovery counts ten-namespace batch responses, while 500 recipients/0.25s above sizes one broad publication. They are different budgets.
